style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial Pre-Lit 7ft Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Transform your home into a winter wonderland with this impressive 7ft artificial pre-lit Christmas tree, designed to deliver maximum festive impact with effortless style. Tall, elegant, and beautifully full, it creates a breathtaking focal point that instantly elevates your seasonal décor. Pre-lit with delicately arranged lights woven throughout the branches, this tree radiates a warm, inviting glow that brings your festive display to life. The built-in illumination saves time and effort, ensuring a perfectly balanced sparkle from top to bottom while beautifully highlighting every decoration you add. Standing at an impressive 7ft, it’s ideal for larger living spaces, hallways or open-plan rooms where you want to make a real statement. The lifelike branches provide a natural, full-bodied appearance, offering the perfect canvas for everything from classic baubles to modern, themed décor. Easy to assemble and designed for repeated use year after year, this pre-lit Christmas tree combines convenience and timeless festive charm. It’s the perfect centrepiece for creating magical Christmas memories with family and friends, season after season. Comes fitted with a standard 3-pin plug. Stand Dims: H17 x W60 cm.
